title: Infosys Pro & Enterprise Features
content: Infosys Pro membership: Rs 4,999/month, Enterprise plan: Rs 15,000/month. Benefits: Unlimited rendering priority, custom API integrations, dynamic video webhooks, custom branding players, and dedicated account manager. Check status in Account > Subscription Settings. If Pro features are locked: 1) Verify invoice payment status. 2) Log out and log back in to refresh token. 3) API key must be re-generated post-upgrade. Refunds for membership: Unused subscription can be refunded within 3 days of auto-renewal.
